result.description:
Are you an organised administrative professional seeking a long-term career opportunity with an iconic, proudly Australian market leader?  
 Randstad is proud to partner with a premier consumer food producer supplying major supermarkets, food service providers, and quick-service restaurant partners across Australia daily. Founded as a family business in 1918, this highly successful organisation has spent over a century building a reputation for quality, convenience, and operational excellence. Driven by a commitment to sustainability and a "people first" philosophy, they invest heavily in the future of their teams and pride themselves on a safe, structured, and genuinely supportive working environment. 
 Operating out of a high-performing manufacturing hub in  Lytton , this position represents a key operational anchor for the facility, transitioning directly from an initial temporary period into a long-term permanent contract.    
 Why Apply? 
 This position is ideal for an administrator looking to combine competitive industry pay with an enviable lifestyle roster. 
 
 
  Attractive Pay Rate:  $38.00-$40.00 per hour + super (casual rate during the initial temporary probation period), potential permanent salary of $68K + super 
 
 
  Work-Life Balance:  A structured 38-hour professional work week featuring consistent daytime hours and an early finish every Friday. 
 
 
  Career Stability:  Step into a secure, long-term role within a massive national supply network that prioritises employee rewards, workplace safety, and career longevity. 
 
 
  Schedule & Roster Structure 
 Enjoy a highly reliable, consistent roster designed to optimise your weekend availability: 
 
 
  Monday to Thursday:  7:00 AM - 3:00 PM 
 
 
  Friday:  7:00 AM - 1:00 PM (Start your weekend early!) 
 
 
  Commencement:  The ideal start is ASAP, though up to a two-week notice period can be accommodated. 
 
 
 About the Organisation 
 Our partner operates with a proud history and an uncompromising commitment to safety, continuous improvement, and sustainable food production. This facility runs tight, reliable operational workflows, providing a structured and stable workspace where your daily contributions are visible and valued. If you are looking for clear career pathways within an industry-leading team that values transparency, quality, and integrity, this is an excellent opportunity. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Based full-time at front reception, you will serve as the essential focal point for site operations. This multi-faceted role perfectly balances highly visible front-of-house customer service with rigorous back-end logistics, data entry, and compliance tracking. 
 Your daily responsibilities will include: 
 
 
  Front of House & Communications:  Greet and sign in visitors, transport providers, and site contractors, while managing site communications via email and Microsoft Teams. 
 
 
  Data Entry & Materials Logistics:  Input operational figures, manage inventory records, and track inbound/outbound material pipelines relating to finished bulk stock and raw materials. 
 
 
  Procurement & Financial Admin:  Utilise internal databases to raise purchase orders for raw materials and site supplies, process commercial quotes, and assist in organising figures for the site budget. 
 
 
  Quality Assurance Coordination:  Coordinate the preparation, dispatch, and digital documentation of operational product samples sent to external testing facilities, following up on results. 
 
 
  Site Housekeeping:  Maintain general administrative spaces, restock office infrastructure (such as printers), and manage structured physical and digital filing systems. 
 
 
  Key Selection Criteria 
 We are looking for a systematic, proactive professional who works effectively toward strict operational deadlines. 
 
 
  Relevant Experience:  A demonstrated background in a multi-faceted office environment encompassing reception duties, high-accuracy data entry, and proactive customer service. 
 
 
  Software Capability:  Intermediate to advanced operational proficiency with Microsoft Excel to track numbers, run formulas, and organise data sheets. Prior exposure to procurement or inventory databases is highly regarded. 
 
 
  Professional Communication:  Confidence collaborating with stakeholders at all levels, managing professional correspondence, and participating actively in digital team environments. 
 
 
  Time Management:  Exceptional organisational skills with a track record of meeting strict production or transport logistics deadlines reliably every week. 
 
 
   Ready to lock in a stable new career with a national leader?  Click  APPLY  today to begin your application with Randstad. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. 
   

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

  Randstad Healthcare is currently seeking a Support at Home Case Manager / Care Partner for an urgent 3-month contract with Heywood Rural Health in South West Victoria.  
 Immediate community aged care opportunities based out of: Portland, Hamilton, and the broader Glenelg Shire region. 
 
 
 Full Accommodation Provided 
 
 
 Travel Support Included 
 
 
 Immediate Start | Minimum 3-Month Contract 
 
 
 Why Case Managers Choose Randstad: 
 
 
 Competitive Pay: Earn strong contract rates + super + travel allowances. 
 
 
 Pay on Demand: Access up to 50% of your pay right after your shift via the myrandstad app. 
 
 
 Exclusive Member Benefits: Discounts on health insurance, home loans, and 50+ major retailers (Woolworths, Amazon, Myer). 
 
 
 Professional Support: Ongoing learning resources and aged care reform insights. 
 
 
 What You'll Be Doing: 
 
 
 Community Case Management: Conduct home reviews, risk assessments, and individualised care plans under the 2026 Support at Home program. 
 
 
 Workforce Support: Guide and supervise local Health Care Workers (HCWs) for safe care delivery. 
 
 
 Multi-Disciplinary Collaboration: Partner with local GPs, Allied Health, and participant families. 
 
 
 Budget & Compliance: Monitor funding allocations and maintain documentation (TRAKCare/RiskMan). 
 
 
 What You'll Need to Apply: 
 
 
 Qualifications: Degree/Diploma in Case Management, Social Work, Psychology, Nursing, or Allied Health. 
 
 
 Experience: Background in community aged care, CHSP, or NDIS support coordination. 
 
 
 Mandatory Checks: Valid VIC Driver's Licence, National Police Check / NDIS Clearance, and current Flu Vaccination. 
 
 
 Working Rights: Full Australian working rights (sponsorship unavailable).

Civil Labourer - Road Construction & Maintenance 
 Are you an experienced plant operator or a hardworking civil labourer looking for your next challenge? Randstad is currently seeking expressions of interest for civil labourer roles within local councils across the Southern area. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for those with a background in roadworks and heavy machinery to secure stable work in a team-oriented environment. We are looking for dedicated individuals who take pride in building and maintaining community infrastructure, with a proactive approach to safety and the ability to operate plant equipment with precision. 
  What You'll Be Doing  
 Your day-to-day will be varied, covering road maintenance and rural projects. Tasks include: 
 
 
  Plant & Truck Operation:  Operating excavators, skid steers and rollers. 
 
 
  Road Maintenance:  Handling construction tasks, including potholing and manual shoveling. 
 
 
  Vegetation Management:  Rural tree trimming using chainsaws and pole saws. 
 
 
  Site Support:  Slings/shifting cement pipes (acting as a spotter for the Rigger) and operating an EWP (under 11m) if licensed. 
 
 
  Traffic Management:  Setting up signage and managing work zones to keep the team and public safe. 
 
 
  Licences and Qualifications Highly Desired:  
 
 
  Medium Rigid (MR) Licence:  Mandatory. 
 
 
  White Card:  General construction induction. 
 
 
 If you're interested, apply via the "Apply Now" - alternatively, you can call 8150 7065 for more information on this role and to find out about other opportunities in South Australia.

Finance Manager  
 Northern Beaches, New South Wales 
   About the Organisation  
 This position sits within a premier, long established commercial precinct located on Sydney's Northern Beaches. Managing a substantial commercial footprint with 94 staff, 1,800 active members, and multi use facilities, the business offers a dynamic, high volume operational environment. The organisation prides itself on delivering high quality service to its members while maintaining strong financial sustainability, robust governance, and long term strategic planning. 
   Role Description  
 Reporting directly to the General Manager, this is the lead finance seat for the business. You will hold full ownership of the financial, accounting, and operational governance functions. Leading an established team of four direct reports, you will provide clear direction and day to day management while ensuring total integrity of all financial records and compliance standards. 
 The role centers heavily on hands on financial management, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, and senior stakeholder engagement. A core requirement is the ability to translate complex financial data into clear commentary and confidently present these insights directly to the General Manager and the Board of Directors. 
 This is a permanent, full time position requiring five days on site on the Northern Beaches, with flexibility required to attend periodic evening Board or Committee meetings. The role offers a competitive salary package of $130,000 to $145,000 + Super, plus an annual performance bonus scheme and standard leave entitlements. 
   Key Responsibilities  
 
 
  Financial Management and Reporting : Manage complete day to day financial operations. Prepare accurate monthly management accounts including P&L statements, Balance Sheets, Cash Flow statements, and key financial performance indicators. 
 
 
  Board and Stakeholder Communication : Prepare, present, and communicate comprehensive financial reports, scenario modelling, and commentary directly to Management and the Board of Directors. 
 
 
  Team Leadership : Provide day to day management, direction, and support to an experienced team of four covering Accounts Payable, Payroll, Membership, and Reception. 
 
 
  Budgeting and Forecasting : Coordinate the annual budgeting process across all operational departments, monitor performance against budget, and deliver accurate cash flow projections. 
 
 
  Statutory Compliance and Audit : Oversee end to end accounting operations, coordinate annual financial statement preparation in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards, and act as the primary liaison for external auditors. 
 
 
  Commercial Asset Oversight : Maintain oversight of treasury, fixed asset registers, capital expenditure, purchasing frameworks, and inventory stocktakes. 
 
 
  Systems and IT Oversight : Act as the primary liaison for external IT providers and support a software migration project on the horizon over the next 12 months. 
 
 
   Qualifications and Skills  
 
 
 A Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline. 
 
 
 Professional accounting qualification (CA, CPA, or working towards) is preferred. 
 
 
 5 plus years of experience in a senior financial management or hands on accounting role. 
 
 
 Proven people management skills with the confidence to lead a strong, long tenured, and established team. 
 
 
 Exceptional communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting complex financial data clearly to non-financial managers and Board members. 
 
 
 Background in hospitality is highly desirable. 
 
 
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, point of sale (POS), and database reporting. 
 
 
   What's on Offer?  
 
 
 Lead finance seat within a well regarded Northern Beaches organisation. 
 
 
 High visibility role with direct exposure to executive management and the Board of Directors. 
 
 
 An attractive remuneration package of $130,000 to $145,000 + Super + Annual Performance Bonus. 
 
 
 On-site parking and scenic Northern Beaches workplace setting. 
 
 
  If you are a hands on, execution focused finance leader with strong team management and board reporting experience, apply now. 
 
 

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent

Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
